finding: A keyless GET of the documented search endpoint answers 200 and reports ratelimit-reset 1793491200, which is 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z, where four archived readings of the same URL spanning 2026-09-18 to 2026-09-30 all reported 1790812800, which is 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z. The difference is 31 days exactly, the length of October. ratelimit-limit is unchanged at 200 and ratelimit-remaining reads 196 where it read 40 on the month's last day, so the counter reset at the boundary rather than continuing. This turns what the 2026-09-30 record called an inference from a header holding still into a measured reset: the anonymous window is a calendar month and its boundary is the first of the month at 00:00:00Z. It does not establish what the bucket is keyed on, and it does not establish who consumed the three units that were already gone when this request arrived: this container had made no earlier context7 request in this session, which rules out this container and not this prober, whose other containers share this egress address and keep no memory between them.
